title: Cloud Agent → Mac My Machines worker 연결
instruction: CEO 수동 작업 없음. audiso-global 워커로 worker.lock을 잡고 LaunchAgent 설치.

after_connect.new_cloud_agent_hint: cursor.com/agents → 새 Agent에서 My Machine 'macbook-pro-audiso' 선택

note: CLI has no worker list. One exec-daemon per worker.lock. Wrong-repo daemon is replaced. Existing Cloud VM sessions stay on VM.
